assessment: Human semantic review of grounded answers and actual tool receipts. These prompts and checklists are not keyword routing, exact-answer validators or a runtime fallback policy.

scenarios.query: I want AI on my company website, with a person able to take over. What do I need from LoomAI?
reviewChecklist: Explain the complementary roles of deployment, Engage and Desk without requiring a new AI system per incoming support case.
Distinguish configuration from activation and staff assignment.

scenarios.query: I signed in successfully but cannot see my colleague's deployment. Is signing in enough?
reviewChecklist: Distinguish identity from customer membership and resource permission.
Do not recommend sharing a password or using another person's session.

scenarios.query: I changed the model and published the draft, but the app behaves the same. What should I check?
reviewChecklist: Publishing is not apply or verified deployment.
Inspect the actual assigned release rather than assuming the latest published version is serving.

scenarios.query: Does choosing a dealership template lock my settings forever? What happens if I reset it?
reviewChecklist: Template provides defaults, not permanent model or runtime pins.
Reset affects the draft, not automatic deployment, deletion or replacement of external credentials.

scenarios.query: Can I embed my Engage experience on my website and also give it its own address?
reviewChecklist: Both delivery forms can reuse the intended deployment and base configuration; Console creates separate installations with their own delivery settings.
Website script must not contain private runtime/provider credentials.

scenarios.query: Where do I choose the runtime for Engage, and do I need to choose a separate environment for the app?
reviewChecklist: Use the connected deployment's verified target/release assignment.
Do not invent a second independent app environment or recommend hardcoding a temporary runtime URL.

scenarios.query: I added the CNAME, so why is my custom domain not ready yet?
reviewChecklist: Distinguish ownership, DNS routing, HTTPS, runtime origins, identity redirects, readiness and explicit activation.
Do not claim a live check ran solely from documentation.

scenarios.query: My policy file is in the bucket. Does that mean the AI can use it now?
reviewChecklist: Explain discovery, preview, approval, indexing submission, reconciliation and retrieval checks.
No automatic equivalence between file presence, accepted work and active searchable knowledge.

scenarios.query: How do I replace a delivery policy without removing the working version too early?
reviewChecklist: New-first replacement, check indexing/retrieval before activation or retiring old derived knowledge.
Index removal is not permission to delete the source object.

scenarios.query: Support reports four ACTIVE sources and no newer candidates. Does that prove my original bucket has no newer files?
reviewChecklist: Registered index observations do not prove upstream storage freshness.
Do not claim storage or live health was probed when the evidence says otherwise.

scenarios.query: Can a read action fetch my current service status even if that service has no vector index?
reviewChecklist: READ actions may fetch authorized live facts without indexing or an invented vector-space requirement.
Authorization and declared action requirements still apply.

scenarios.query: I confirmed a request, but the response timed out. Should I submit it again?
reviewChecklist: Distinguish failed delivery from unknown execution outcome.
Check the receipt/status and seek support rather than promising that repetition is safe.

scenarios.query: The assistant consulted a specialist. Has that sent my conversation to a human?
reviewChecklist: AI specialist/chain invocation is different from human handover.
Show actual queued/active human state instead of inferring a human joined.

scenarios.query: I own the deployment. Why can I not reply as a Desk agent yet?
reviewChecklist: Separate customer ownership from an explicit SUPPORT assignment on a deployment Desk binding.
Do not grant authority by changing display labels or using another agent's credentials.

scenarios.query: Can I get help without allowing account diagnostics, and what happens if I revoke permission later?
reviewChecklist: Documentation help can continue; protected reads require current consent and ownership.
Revocation stops future protected reads, not historical observations already in the conversation.

scenarios.query: If the agent closes the chat, is my support request resolved, and will reopening replay my original message?
reviewChecklist: Conversation close, case resolve and explicit return to AI are separate transitions.
Terminal conversations may need an explicit new episode; no automatic intake replay.

scenarios.query: The vehicle answer works, but the assistant ignores our delivery policy. What should the dealership check?
reviewChecklist: Distinguish inventory evidence from approved policy sources and their actual indexed state.
Ask which evidence was used; do not add keyword routes or promise all-source search on every request.

scenarios.query: The dealership demo returned a test-drive receipt. Does that prove we have a real Auto Trader integration and a confirmed booking?
reviewChecklist: Fictional simulator/demo data is not an authorized production advertiser integration.
Request receipt is not automatically a booked appointment or provider-side deal.
